spec.assertion: Asserts a boss-held buffApply (casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null) with stat damageTakenPct and value 3.9, carrying a finite expiresFrame. Fails under the nearest-wrong models: (a) encoded as a self/ally buff (targetIdx!==null asserted empty), (b) modeled as a permanent passive (single frame-0 apply, no expiry).

Asserts recovery events strictly outnumber activations (10 ticks per activation, intervalSec 1) and reach EVERY ally. Fails under ticks:1 (one instant heal per activation) and under self-only targeting. Tandem-relevant: this drives teammates' on-recovery triggers, so it is not inert on isolation.

Header says "Activates at the START of battle", so first fire must be t=0; the engine's bare interval trigger first-fires at t=sec. Asserts the first debuff apply is at frame <=1. Fails under a lone interval{sec:30} with no t=0 fire (opening 30s window empty).

it.skip — aggro/taunt has no primitive and the v1 boss deals no damage, so the payload is unobservable. Noted as gated by S2 bonus e3, so both lines must be recorded together in `unmodeled` rather than silently dropped.

Asserts a 23.51 critDamagePct apply reaching at least one non-Emma target. Fails under the self-only nearest-wrong. The exact 'same squad' membership axis does not exist in the data — flagged ⛑: the test pins that the buff is NOT self-only and NOT absent, but cannot pin squad membership without a squad field (recipe: add a squad axis to characters.json, or owner-rule the allies-scope stand-in as noir's `teamHas.slugs` precedent did).

Asserts the per-target SUM of projectileExplosionPct is 5.41 (base 2.32 + AS-Formation bonus 3.09) across every unit in the comp. Fails if either line is dropped (2.32 or 3.09 alone) or if breadth is narrowed below all allies.

Asserts a 30.97 trueDamagePct apply on every ally, plus a counterfactual (effect stripped via withPatchedOverride on ov.skill2) that strictly LOWERS ally totals — proving it feeds the Damage Up bucket rather than sitting inert. Fails under the self-scoped reading (the block header's 'to self' is the CONDITION; the effect's own target line says all allies).

Covered by the 5.41 sum assertion — discriminates additive stacking of the two projectile-explosion lines from modeling only one. Note: on a comp with no RL kit this stat is engine-inert for damage; the assertion is on the emitted buff, not on totals, so it stays valid (rule 7: keep the stat even if inert).
it.skip — disables an unmodeled taunt, so inert by construction. Must be documented in `unmodeled`; encoding it as any stat would be an invention.

A CADENCE line that is damage-visible: 30s→10s recurrence turns the 10s-on/20s-off debuff into a continuous one. Asserts >=12 debuff activations over 180s, and a counterfactual forcing sec=30 that produces strictly fewer activations AND strictly lower team damage. Fails under the 'defensive/skip' nearest-wrong (line dropped as non-damage) — the classic failure-mode-6 trap.

Asserts casterAtkPct applies flat-resolved (value >>100, ≈ 0.4007 × Emma's staticAtk) and that NO plain atkPct 40.07 exists. Fails under the mis-encoding as target-scaled atkPct — a Supporter's ATK differs from an Attacker's, so the two models diverge materially. Breadth + 10s finite expiry also asserted.

Asserts the first casterAtkPct apply frame precedes the first fullBurstStart frame — the burst cast lands BEFORE the FB window opens (verified fact). Fails under a fullBurstEnter re-key, which would over-credit in multi-caster rotations and mis-time the 10s window.

Asserts a 7.8 boss-debuff value exists (3.9 × 2) while 103.9 and 100 do NOT — discriminating 'scaled by 100%' (a doubling) from a flat +100pp add. Non-vacuity: BOTH the 3.9 (un-enhanced) and 7.8 (enhanced) cases must appear in the same run. A strip-counterfactual proves it lowers EVERY unit's damage, confirming boss-debuff scope rather than self-buff.

it.skip — the engine emits recovery events with no HP amount, so a heal-amplification percentage has no consumer and no observable payload. Must live in `unmodeled`; encoding it as a damage stat would be a fabrication.

Three inertness groups: no crit-rate/core/charge/element buffs from Emma's slot; no ammo/reload/fire-rate/attack-speed modifiers; and every damage event from her slot is a plain normal/core weapon hit (no invented flatDamage rider on a pure support kit).

fixtures: controlComp('emma-tactical-upgrade', true) — single fixture, deterministic (no seed). Emma is Burst I, so the control comp's B2 + B3 chain lets a full rotation actually complete and she casts her own burst each cycle (a fixture without the chain would emit ZERO full bursts and make every burst assertion vacuous). fixedB3=true is kept because the fixed B3 slot's buffs do not touch damageTakenPct, projectileExplosionPct, trueDamagePct or casterAtkPct — the four stats every assertion filters on — and all buff assertions additionally filter by casterIdx!==null plus the exact kit magnitude, so a co-caster cannot satisfy them. Counterfactuals reuse the same comp via overrides:{'emma-tactical-upgrade': withPatchedOverride(...)}, isolating exactly one kit line per patched run. Total runs: 1 base + 3 counterfactual = 4, well under the ~20-run budget.
gaps: skill1 'Exposure / Attract: Taunt all enemies continuously' — it.skip: no aggro/taunt primitive and the v1 boss deals no damage, so the payload is unobservable. Not free-standing flavor (S2 bonus e3 gates it) — both belong in `unmodeled`.
skill2 bonus e3 'Exposure activation disabled' — it.skip: disables the unmodeled taunt above, therefore inert by construction; encoding it as any stat would be an invention.
burst e2 'Incoming healing ▲ 29.04%' — it.skip: heal amounts are not modeled (recovery events carry no HP quantity), so a heal-amplification percentage has no consumer.

⚑ FLAGGED, NOT GUESSED — skill2 e1 'allies from the SAME SQUAD': the data has no squad axis, so the true target set is outside the input domain. The test pins only that the buff is neither absent nor self-only. Recipe: add a squad field to data/characters.json (or an owner ruling using the noir `teamHas.slugs` precedent) before the scope can be asserted exactly; until then the allies-scope stand-in may OVER-credit on a mixed-squad comp.

⚑ FLAGGED — 'AS Formation' (the S2 bonus gate) is a kit formation/mode with no stated in-battle activation condition. Read as always-on for a standard team (modeled via `modes` or an ungated block); if it is in fact conditional, all four bonus effects (incl. the -20s interval, which is damage-visible) would be over-credited. Recipe: confirm the AS-Formation condition from the in-game formation UI or a datamined condition field.

⚑ FLAGGED — cadence tuple: MG base fire rate / reloadFrames 171 come from datamine fields on the known-unreliable list; no assertion in this file depends on absolute shot counts (the damage-event assertion checks buckets only), so the flag does not gate any test here.
